title: Baptism of Steel
description: Training's over. The client is Halworth's timber concern out of Elder Moor - a bandit outpost has been stripping their wagons on the logging road for three weeks straight, and the mill's paid crew hasn't drawn full wages since. Halworth is paying the Company's full rate to make it stop. Follow orders, hold formation, don't break ranks - that's the whole lesson from drill, paid for in someone else's coin this time.

objectives.description: March to the outpost that's been hitting Halworth's wagons
Clear the outpost with your squad, in formation
Bring down the bandit leader running the toll
Report the road clear to Captain Steele

notes: Threat: Halworth's timber crew going unpaid while the road's cut - invented client, local colour, no bible basis. Giver motive: Steele fields the contract, the client is Halworth, never seen on the page. Consequence: if this dragged on, the mill's crew starves through winter (echoes logging_troubles' unstated stake without contradicting it - different crew, same road).
